title: 第11章 破庙乞丐第12章 争先机
lines: 一碗大药入肚，魏乐府只觉得浑身通透。
这一碗可就要十两银子，不过他一点都不带心疼钱的，把大药当成佐餐来喝。
三餐吃饱后，就直接喝一碗下肚溜溜缝。
要是钱够的话，很快就能让沉寂的两个天赋复苏，然后三个月内把三门武学练到大成。
正常人肯定办不到的，这么喝药别说练成了，先把自己给喝死了。
是药三分毒，但架不住他有鲸吞蚕食这个天赋。
这个天赋本身确实只是个大胃袋，可在龙精虎猛和老弟的重楼功元灵状态结合下，把它推到了不属于它的高度。
但凡少一个，都没有这么强的效果。
所以到现在魏乐府都不明白，沈千钧到底是怎么做到的。
总不能对方也有个大胃袋吧，可对方吃的也不多的样子。
哪里像魏乐府，这才来六扇门第三天呢，就已经是六扇门里远近闻名的大胃王。
而沈千钧可是在四方武馆里练了四个月，真是大胃袋的话，魏乐府怎么可能会不知道。
这种事想藏都藏不住的。
现在的问题是...钱不够用了。
一顿十两，三顿可就是三十两。
一天三十两那可是相当离谱的支出了。
他手上一共还有四十两，所以得等方则言能给他送多少礼。
保守估计有个五百两，够他用一段时间了。
至于之后，那等之后再说。
反正距离任务结束还有三天时间，先顾眼前的事情再说吧。
事实上，他现在都还比较无奈，圆相的踪迹依旧没有找到。
好在因为他的大方，倒是暗中收拢了不少人作为他的‘线人’。
所以他现在成了名声不错但迫切想要立功的丁捕头。
对外，他是一直在以缉盗追凶的名义摸排走访的，也是他故意立的这种人设。
随着他巡街结束，方则言就掐准了时间前来拜访。
这次可不是他一个人来的，还带了家丁仆从。
一番寒暄后，给魏乐府送了礼就又客套两句后，这才离开。
对方给的礼还真不少。
魏乐府确实估准了银两重量，不过除了银两外还有一支百年老山参以及一些名贵药材。
离开前表示每个月都会有孝敬，只是孝敬肯定没有这第一回的多了。
对此，魏乐府就当作没听懂，等拿到手了再说。
东西收了之后，魏乐府就拿着银子直奔药铺采买。
交了钱就让药铺伙计给他送回去，这一次他买了七天的量。
五百两到手都没捂热乎呢，就用了两百一十两。
倒也不用担心药铺敢跟他以次充好，他这一身官皮子就是震慑。
甚至他都不用讨价还价，人家直接给他最低价。
“丁爷，听说你在找形迹可疑的人？”一个老乞丐凑了过来。
魏乐府看了他一眼，倒是觉得稀奇，毕竟能活这么大年龄的乞丐可是相当少见了。
content_en:
After taking a big bowl of medicine into his stomach, Wei Yuefu felt that his whole body was clear.
This bowl cost ten taels of silver, but he didn't care about the money at all and drank the medicine as a side dish.
After three meals, I would just drink a bowl of it and eat it up.
If you have enough money, you can quickly revive the two dormant talents, and then master the three martial arts to perfection within three months.
Normal people would definitely not be able to do it. Let alone practice it by drinking medicine like this, they would drink themselves to death first.
It's a medicine that's three parts poison, but it can't stop him from having the talent to devour it.
This talent itself is indeed just a big stomach bag, but the combination of the dragon spirit, tiger ferocity and my brother's Chonglou Kung Yuan Ling state has pushed it to a level that does not belong to it.
Any one less would not have such a strong effect.
So Wei Yuefu still doesn't understand how Shen Qianjun did it.
It's impossible for the other party to have a big stomach, but the other party doesn't seem to eat much.
It's nothing like Wei Yuefu. It's only the third day since he came to Liumen, and he's already the famous big eater in Liumen.
And Shen Qianjun has been training in Sifang Martial Arts Hall for four months. If he is really a big stomach, how could Wei Yuefu not know about it.
You can't hide this kind of thing even if you want to.
The problem now is... there's not enough money.
One meal is twelve taels, three meals is thirty taels.
Thirty taels a day is quite an outrageous expense.
He still had a total of forty taels on hand, so he had to wait and see how many gifts Fang Zeyan could give him.
A conservative estimate of five hundred taels would be enough for him to use for a while.
As for what happens next, let’s wait until later.
Anyway, there are still three days until the end of the mission, so let’s focus on the things in front of us first.
In fact, he is still relatively helpless now, as there is still no trace of Yuan Xiang.
Fortunately, because of his generosity, he secretly recruited many people as his 'informants'.
So now he has become Ding Baotou, who has a good reputation but is eager to make meritorious deeds.
To the outside world, he has been visiting platoons in the name of hunting down thieves and chasing down murderers, and this is also a persona he deliberately set up.
As he finished his patrol, Fang Zeyan made time to visit.
This time he didn't come alone, he also brought his servants.
After some pleasantries, he gave Wei Yuefu a gift and said a few polite words before leaving.
The gifts given by the other party were quite a lot.
Wei Yuefu did estimate the weight of the silver taels, but in addition to the silver taels, there was also a century-old wild ginseng and some precious medicinal materials.
Before leaving, he said that he would pay filial piety every month, but the filial piety would definitely not be as much as this first time.
Regarding this, Wei Yuefu pretended not to understand and would wait until he got it.
After collecting the things, Wei Yuefu took the money and went straight to the drug store to buy.
After paying the money, he asked the pharmacy clerk to send it back to him. This time he bought a seven-day supply.
I didn't warm my hands even though I had five hundred taels, so I only used two hundred and ten taels.
You don't have to worry about the drug store daring to pass him off as a good product. His official appearance is a deterrent.
He didn't even have to bargain, they just gave him the lowest price.
"Master Ding, I heard that you are looking for someone acting suspiciously?" An old beggar came over.
Wei Yuefu glanced at him and felt strange. After all, it was quite rare for beggars to live to such an old age.
title_en: Chapter 11 The Beggar in the Ruined Temple Chapter 12 Seizing the Opportunity
